meta.name: story-cover
meta.description: 小说封面生成。根据书名、作者名自动分析题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成含标题和署名的专业级网文封面；Codex CLI 优先使用内置 ImageGen，无需单独 API Key。触发方式：/story-cover、/封面、「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」「做个小说封面」「封面设计」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入书名和作者，自动生成专业网文封面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想为网文生成专业封面而不懂设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate a novel cover with title and author from book info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a polished cover for your web novel

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 充当小说封面设计师:读取书名与作者名,判定题材风格,生成含书名和署名的竖版封面图并保存到指定输出目录,平台有固定像素时另存一份上传尺寸版本。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-cover 或 /封面,或说「帮我做个封面」等话时接管;若书名或笔名缺失,它会先追问补全,不自行编造。

say.text: 帮我做个封面,书名《长夜行》,笔名青衫客,发番茄小说
say.note: 先确认书名笔名,再出 2-3 个构图方案

say.text: 用 /封面 生成三个构图方案,存到 ./covers/长夜行
say.note: 每个方案单独调用一次并落盘

say.text: 书名换成《夜航船》,书名字体改成霓虹发光风格
say.note: 重新出图,旧版本自增不覆盖

howto.what_en: After install, Claude acts as a novel cover designer: it reads the book title and pen name, infers the genre style, generates a vertical cover image carrying the title and author name, saves it to your chosen output folder, and exports a platform upload-size version when fixed pixels are required.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you run /story-cover or /封面, or ask it to make a cover; if the title or pen name is missing it asks you to fill them in first.

say_en.text: Make me a cover: title 'Night Journey', pen name Qingshan Ke, for Fanqie Novel
say_en.note: It confirms title and pen name, then offers 2-3 compositions

say_en.text: Use /封面 to generate three composition options into ./covers/NightJourney
say_en.note: Each option is generated and saved separately

say_en.text: Change the title to 'Night Boat' and use a neon glowing title font
say_en.note: It regenerates; older versions are kept
